react.description: A guided tour: each step is a dialog next to its target (a Popover), over an overlay with a spotlight cut-out around the target (a Backdrop), or a beacon to open it. The core walktour controller renders the state this component keeps; `run` starts it, `stepIndex` + `onStepChange` control the step.
